title: Efectos de sonido
description: docs/audio.md § Effects: every synth recipe rendered offline and measured (it has to make a sound and not clip), and each sound that goes on (the bubble's hiss, far and close), the effects lab's Sonidos buttons, then a real fight against El Cebollón logging each sound asked for and in what order.

steps.eval: (async () => { const { SOUNDS, BEDS } = await import('/src/sfx.ts'); const rows = []; for (const [id, sound] of Object.entries(SOUNDS)) { const c = new OfflineAudioContext(1, 48000 * 2.2, 48000); const seconds = sound.synth(c, c.destination, .01, 1); const data = (await c.startRendering()).getChannelData(0); let peak = 0, sum = 0; for (const v of data) { peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); sum += v * v; } let last = 0; for (let i = data.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (Math.abs(data[i]) > .0005) { last = i / 48000; break; } rows.push({ id, peak, rms: Math.sqrt(sum / Math.max(1, last * 48000)), seconds, last }); } for (const [id, make] of Object.entries(BEDS)) for (const drive of [0, 1]) { const c = new OfflineAudioContext(1, 48000 * 3, 48000); const bed = make(c, c.destination, 0); bed.drive(drive, 0); bed.stop(2.5); const data = (await c.startRendering()).getChannelData(0); let peak = 0, sum = 0; for (let i = 24000; i < 120000; i++) { const v = data[i]; peak = Math.max(peak, Math.abs(v)); sum += v * v; } let last = 0; for (let i = data.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (Math.abs(data[i]) > .0005) { last = i / 48000; break; } rows.push({ id: `${id}·${drive}`, peak, rms: Math.sqrt(sum / 96000), seconds: 2.5, last }); } window.sfxReport = rows; const el = document.createElement('pre'); el.id = 'sfx-report'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:12px;top:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:9999;margin:0;padding:12px 16px;background:#101410f2;color:#e8f0e0;font:12px/1.42 ui-monospace,monospace;columns:2;column-gap:28px;overflow:hidden;width:calc(100vw - 340px)'; el.textContent = rows.map(r => `${r.id.padEnd(12)} pico ${r.peak.toFixed(2)}  rms ${r.rms.toFixed(3)}  ${r.last.toFixed(2)} s`).join('\n'); document.body.append(el); })()

steps.until: window.sfxReport.every(r => r.peak > .03 && r.peak <= 1 && r.last > .02 && r.last < r.seconds + .2)

steps.caption: Every sound rendered and measured: each makes a sound, none clips, each ends when it says; the bubble's hiss far (·0) and close (·1)
The effects lab: a button for each sound, to hear them (just dev-fx)

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.fightReady = () => document.querySelector('#hud[data-battle]') && window.gerard.battleUI.fight?.phase === 'player' && !window.gerard.battleUI.fight.busy && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.turnOf = id => window.fightReady() && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; { const set = window.gerard.game.setBattle; window.gerard.game.setBattle = (state, ...rest) => { window.fightState = state; return set(state, ...rest); }; } window.sounds = []; { const play = window.gerard.sfx.play; window.gerard.sfx.play = (id, options) => { if (!id.startsWith('ui-')) window.sounds.push(id); return play(id, options); }; }

{ const el = document.createElement('pre'); el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:16px;top:100px;z-index:9999;margin:0;padding:10px 14px;background:#101410f2;color:#e8f0e0;font:13px/1.45 ui-monospace,monospace'; el.textContent = 'Sonidos pedidos en una ronda:\n' + window.sounds.join('\n'); document.body.append(el); }
